name: eden
description: Connect Eden to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Eden MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Eden to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with creator content and posts using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Eden workspace.
Find anything in Eden that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review creator content and posts in Eden.
